decisionsFormat.id: Existing guide ID, or stable new guide ID
decisionsFormat.question: Owner question

evidence.readScope: Actual text read; distinguish failed response/shell

decisionsFormat.guidePatch: Editable fields for existing guide OR complete new published-guide record

newSources.record: Complete source record with actual access/review dates and next-review target

newRules.record: Complete rule record with sources and dependent paths

ruleUpdates.fields: Explicit verified changes; no automatic date/status changes

decisionsFormat.unresolved: Specific remaining uncertainty; do not rename as resolved

guideContract.sections: Stable ID, heading, plain paragraphs/bullets/meaningful table, sourceIds; preserve existing aliases when replacing.
guideContract.audience: SMB brand owner; explain central terms inline; context and consequence before forms or legal codes.
guideContract.examples: Clearly label fictional examples; distinguish actual allegations, orders, proposed orders and paid recovery.
guideContract.contentPolicy: No word minimum, forced table/glossary/quiz, invented current rule or human legal-approval requirement.
